conditional_findings.classification: Recovered059 Segovb environmental-sample admission question newly reassessed at95e; no new historical finding or checkpoint3821 attribution.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Terrain-pack canopy percent, shared EnvironmentalSample basis-point fields, and the regional versus tactical admission boundary.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The shared percent-to-basis-point adapter can carry values above one whole into RegionalTerrain, whereas tactical grid validation rejects such environmental values and the inspected presentation fraction adapter saturates them.
conditional_findings.trace: The earlier Segovb Lens12 READ672 at6533 explicitly left actual Cell decoder bounds and RegionalTerrain/environment wire admission unresolved. At95e TerrainPack chunk checks decoded length/hash and surface/flag discriminants, then copies raw canopy byte4 into Cell without an inspected <=100 predicate. terrain_sampling::environment_sample multiplies that u8 by100 into a u16 basis-point field. RegionalTerrain::new and its serde TryFrom check the fixed65x65 vertex count but do not check environmental fractions. The regional mesh maps retained samples through vista_sample_color and the shared bps helper, which calls UnitBasisPoints::saturating. Tactical scene sampling uses the same environment_sample and TacticalSceneInput::validate_source calls validate_grid, which rejects any environmental value above10000.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: A hypothetical decoded cell with canopy byte101, valid surface and flags, and a correctly matched decoded checksum maps to10100 basis points. The inspected RegionalTerrain count predicate has no canopy restriction and the presentation fraction adapter maps10100 to10000 (1.0); a tactical grid containing that sample reaches the inspected >10000 rejection. This is symbolic source arithmetic, not a constructed pack, deserialization, generator, validator or image.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The checked-in pack builder explicitly converts raw canopy values above100 to0 before writing, so the inspected normal builder does not emit the hypothetical byte101. TerrainPack additionally checks decoded length and hash against its manifest. No actual package value, supported external pack with matching manifest, source failure, scene rejection or displayed difference was observed. The region renderer deliberately saturates at its material boundary, and valid source values remain in range. Intentional handling of out-of-range raw values and whether RegionalTerrain is trusted-only require policy and producer evidence.
